Drilling to the original 80-metre depth would yield insufficient recharge during the peak dry months (January–March). The 6 affected sites are all in the same geological belt.
- **Impact Assessment (Procurement):** The contractor (Sahel Borehole Services Ltd.) has quoted an additional NGN 1,120,000 (excluding VAT) for the increased depth, calculated at the same per-metre rate as the original contract. No change to the delivery schedule is required; the contractor confirmed that the rigs can absorb the extra depth without delaying the handover dates. The contract value will increase by the quoted amount.
